title: Har Housie mein yeh 4 log!
format: Kitty Gang types-of-players at the theme's Housie

experiment.hook: 3 gang faces on the Trick or Treat home art with the banner 'Har Housie mein yeh 4 log!' and reactions flying
experiment.variable: a numbered list of 4 relatable player types (recognition and tagging) instead of one two-person story
experiment.hypothesis: people tag the friend they recognise: at least 3 shares and watched % above 25, skip under 60%

idea: Four Housie types in Trick or Treat Housie: the early claimer, the double checker, the reaction spammer, and the quiet one who actually wins Full House.
beats: hook: Har Housie mein 4 log / type 1: Ishita claims Lollipops after one number / type 2: Shruti checks again and again / type 3: Zoya spams ghost reactions, misses the number / turn: Aditi silently gets Full House / button: Aditi's deadpan line to Ishita
caption: {theme} Housie mein aap kaun ho: 1, 2, 3 ya 4? Comment mein number likho aur us saheli ko tag karo!

lines.text: Abhi toh ek number aaya hai!
lines.say: अभी तो एक नंबर आया है!

lines.text: Ek baar aur check karti hoon.
lines.say: एक बार और चेक करती हूँ।

lines.text: Jab tum claim kar rahi thi.
lines.say: जब तुम क्लेम कर रही थी।
